{{Quote|Life is a challenge, and facing that challenge is what make the good great.|Deela jan Morolla, [[32,920 BBY]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
'''Deela jan Morolla''' was a [[Je'daii Master]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] circa [[32,920 BBY]]. She warned that not all [[Je'daii Journeyer]] would complete their [[Great Journey]], as Tython and the morality of the Order posed a great many challenges to the youth. But Morolla also warned that Je'daii should accept these loses as life was not driven by absolutes, but by challenges. In [[32,914 BBY]], Morolla would be quoted as encouraging Je'daii to remember that the inhabitants of the system were brought to Tython, and that the world existed long before they arrived. The Master cautioned that Tython's age was deep, and that the Je'daii were merely passing through, and that their true home was [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
